ourStory.title: Heritage craft. Kolkata fusion finish.
paragraphs: Since 1983 we have served more than 100 families as wholesaler and retailer — turning your inspiration into gold and silver you can wear with confidence.
Our karigars handle consult, specs, model approval, casting, setting, polish, and quality checks under one roof — Kolkata fusion styling with transparent weight and purity.
Today we work with customers nationwide: live gold rates, WhatsApp estimates, and the same custom-first approach that built our name in fine jewellery.
